policy_name: Resolution 29/2021/QH15 on medium-term public investment plan 2021-2025
summary: Set the 2021-2025 public investment framework, reinforcing infrastructure as a location and demand driver for residential development.
notes: Official source; relevance is indirect through infrastructure-led urban development.

policy_name: Resolution 43/2022/QH15 on fiscal and monetary support for recovery
summary: Approved recovery support policies, including public investment and credit-related measures that could affect construction activity and housing demand.
notes: Official source; real estate impact is indirect and depends on implementation.

policy_name: Decree 65/2022/ND-CP amending private corporate bond rules
summary: Tightened private corporate bond issuance and trading requirements, increasing funding discipline and refinancing pressure for bond-dependent developers.
notes: Official source; high uncertainty because funding effects vary by developer balance sheet.

policy_name: Decision 1435/QD-TTg establishing Prime Minister working group for real estate project bottlenecks
summary: Created a working group to review and guide resolution of difficulties in implementing real estate projects for localities and enterprises.
notes: Official Government Portal source.

policy_name: Decree 08/2023/ND-CP amending and suspending selected corporate bond rules
summary: Relaxed selected private bond rules and allowed negotiated settlement mechanisms, reducing near-term refinancing stress but preserving market scrutiny.
notes: Official source.

policy_name: Resolution 33/NQ-CP on solutions for safe and sustainable real estate market development
summary: Directed ministries and localities to remove legal bottlenecks, support credit access, and promote a healthier real estate market.
notes: Official source.

policy_name: Official Dispatch 2308/NHNN-TD guiding the VND 120 trillion social housing credit program
summary: Guided commercial banks on implementing the credit program for social housing, worker housing, and apartment renovation projects under Resolution 33.
notes: Official SBV source; implementation depends on eligible project lists and bank appraisal.

policy_name: Decision 338/QD-TTg approving the 1 million social housing apartment program
summary: Approved the program to develop at least 1 million social housing apartments for low-income earners and industrial park workers during 2021-2030.
notes: Official source.

policy_name: Decree 10/2023/ND-CP amending decrees guiding the Land Law
summary: Amended land-law implementation rules, including land administration procedures relevant to project legality and asset certification.
notes: Official source; specific project effects require legal review.

policy_name: Housing Law 2023
summary: Replaced the 2014 housing framework and reset rules affecting housing development, ownership, social housing, apartment management, and housing programs.
notes: Official source; high uncertainty until implementing guidance and local execution are assessed.

policy_name: Real Estate Business Law 2023
summary: Updated rules for real estate business activities, market regulation, disclosures, and conditions for real estate transactions.
notes: Official source; market impact depends on implementation decrees and enforcement.

policy_name: Land Law 2024
summary: Replaced the 2013 Land Law, reshaping land allocation, land pricing, compensation, land-use rights, and land administration for development projects.
notes: Official source; key uncertainty is implementation and local land-price application.

policy_name: Law on Credit Institutions 2024
summary: Updated the legal framework for credit institutions, affecting banking governance and credit discipline relevant to developer and homebuyer financing.
notes: Official source; real estate impact is indirect through credit allocation and risk management.

policy_name: Law 43/2024/QH15 amending effective dates of Land Law, Housing Law, Real Estate Business Law, and Credit Institutions Law
summary: Accelerated the effective date of major real estate-related laws to support faster policy implementation and market resolution.
notes: Official source.

policy_name: Decree 94/2024/ND-CP on housing and real estate market information database
summary: Detailed the construction and management of housing and real estate market information systems and databases.
notes: Official source; transparency benefits depend on data quality and reporting compliance.

policy_name: Decree 95/2024/ND-CP detailing selected articles of the Housing Law
summary: Provided implementing guidance for the Housing Law, reducing ambiguity around housing administration and ownership-related procedures.
notes: Official source.

policy_name: Decree 96/2024/ND-CP detailing selected articles of the Real Estate Business Law
summary: Provided implementing guidance for real estate business rules, including requirements relevant to project sales and market conduct.
notes: Official source.

policy_name: Decree 98/2024/ND-CP on renovation and reconstruction of apartment buildings
summary: Detailed mechanisms for apartment renovation and reconstruction, potentially unlocking redevelopment supply in urban areas.
notes: Official source.

policy_name: Decree 100/2024/ND-CP on development and management of social housing
summary: Detailed social housing development and management rules, supporting the policy push toward affordable and worker housing supply.
notes: Official source.

policy_name: Decree 102/2024/ND-CP detailing implementation of the Land Law
summary: Provided detailed implementation rules for the Land Law, affecting land allocation, conversion, registration, and administrative execution.
notes: Official source; high uncertainty because local execution can materially affect project timelines.

policy_name: Law on Urban and Rural Planning 2024
summary: Established a planning framework for urban and rural areas, relevant to long-term land use, project pipeline visibility, and infrastructure-led development.
notes: Official source; effects depend on subordinate guidance and local planning quality.

policy_name: Resolution 171/2024/QH15 on pilot commercial housing projects through land-use-right agreements
summary: Piloted commercial housing project implementation through agreements to receive or use existing land-use rights, potentially widening legal pathways for land bank conversion.
notes: Official source; high uncertainty because project eligibility and provincial implementation matter.

policy_name: Resolution 170/2024/QH15 on special mechanisms for stuck land and project cases in HCMC, Da Nang, and Khanh Hoa
summary: Created special mechanisms to address land and project difficulties linked to inspection, audit, and court conclusions in selected localities.
notes: Official source; geographically targeted and execution-sensitive.

policy_name: Decree 75/2025/ND-CP detailing Resolution 171/2024/QH15
summary: Provided implementation rules for the pilot commercial housing pathway using land-use-right agreements or existing land-use rights.
notes: Official source.

policy_name: Resolution 201/2025/QH15 on special mechanisms for social housing development
summary: Piloted special mechanisms and policies to accelerate social housing development.
notes: Official source.

policy_name: Decree 302/2025/ND-CP on the National Housing Fund and implementation of Resolution 201/2025/QH15
summary: Detailed the National Housing Fund and measures to implement special social housing development mechanisms.
notes: Official source.

policy_name: Decree 357/2025/ND-CP on housing and real estate market information database
summary: Updated rules on building and managing housing and real estate market information databases, effective in early 2026.
notes: Official source; dated 2025 but effective 2026.
